svg.aria-label: What a trace review found about next lines. Followed: every next line from brief to board. Not followed: after dev the same strip line 13 of 13 times; after strip, 0 of 6 compare calls carried the reference; after critique the fresh judge was not run.

g.text: Trace review, 2026-10-10: did the agent follow the next line?
After new, refs, design, states, board: followed in order
After dev: the same strip line printed 13 of 13 times, even after 18 strips were read
After strip: 0 of 6 compare calls carried the reference named in the brief
After critique: the fresh-session judge was not run; the agent shipped 2 minutes later
The fix for the second row: dev now names the next unmet step (commit b5df5ed).
